editorial:
Imagine being a Necromonger, one of those scary dark soldiers from the Chronicles of Riddick universe, but instead of conquering planets, you are just trying to get through your daily routine. That is the hilarious setup of Necromonger Dave. You follow Dave, a regular guy stuck in the armor and mindset of a galactic conqueror, as he navigates ordinary problems like grocery shopping, awkward small talk, and office politics. The vibe is silly and lighthearted, mixing sci-fi weirdness with everyday comedy. It feels like a sketch stretched into a full movie, but in a good way. You will laugh at how seriously Dave takes everything while the world around him just shrugs.

The acting is surprisingly committed, especially the lead who never breaks character. The pacing stays quick with short, punchy scenes. Pros: genuinely funny moments and a unique premise. Cons: some jokes repeat and the story is thin. Great for fans of absurd comedy. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Dave finally snaps and tries to conquer his office building like a true Necromonger. But instead of fear, his coworkers just ignore him and keep working. The twist reveals Dave was never actually a Necromonger at all, just a guy in cosplay who got too deep into character. He takes off the helmet, laughs, and goes home. The movie ends with him ordering pizza in normal clothes.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves absurd sci-fi comedy and lighthearted laughs.
